Rules.title: Borrowing rules
Rules.intro: These rules come straight from the library system, so they're always current.
Rules.validity: {years, plural, one {Membership is valid for # year and can be renewed online or at the desk.} other {Membership is valid for # years and can be renewed online or at the desk.}}
Rules.loansText: Your due date is shown in My account. If it falls on a day the library is closed, it moves to the next open day.
Rules.renewText: You can renew a loan online, up to your type's limit, unless someone has reserved the book or your borrowing is blocked. A renewal starts from the day you renew.
Rules.referenceText: Reference books (dictionaries, encyclopedias) can only be read in the library.
Rules.fineLate: Late returns: LKR {perDay} per item per day, starting {grace, plural, =0 {on the day after the due date} one {after # grace day} other {after # grace days}}, up to LKR {max} per item.
Rules.fineLost: Lost books: the book's price (or LKR {defaultPrice} if unknown) plus a LKR {processing} processing fee.
Rules.fineDamaged: Damaged books: an amount set by staff, up to the replacement cost.
Rules.fineBlock: Borrowing is paused while you owe LKR {amount} or more. Pay online or at the desk.
Rules.holdsText: You can reserve a book when no copy is on the shelf. When one comes back you'll be told, and it waits for you on the hold shelf for {days, plural, one {# open day} other {# open days}}.
Rules.privacyText: Your reading history is private. You can turn it off in Settings. Photos of ID documents are deleted {days} days after your application is decided.

faqItems.q1: Can I borrow without being a member?
faqItems.a1: You can read in the library and use the catalog. To take books home, apply for membership online.
faqItems.q2: How do I renew a book?
faqItems.a2: In My account, open your loans and choose Renew. You can also renew at the desk.
faqItems.q3: I lost my library card. What now?
faqItems.a3: Your digital card is always in My account. You can download and print it again.
